32970396.outcome: Trial-defined major kidney / cardiorenal composite (components differ by trial)
32970396.source: DAPA-CKD (PMID 32970396) abstract: primary composite (sustained >=50% eGFR decline, ESKD, or renal/CV death) 197/2152 dapagliflozin vs 312/2152 placebo (hazard ratio, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.72; P<0.001). SCALE CORRECTION (override): the CT.gov/abstract count extractor pooled a count-derived RR into the HR pool; the trial reports the kidney-composite HR 0.61 directly.
32970396.verification: Reported HR 0.61 (0.51-0.72) verbatim; primary composite INCLUDES CV death, consistent with EMPA-KIDNEY and CREDENCE primaries (all CV-death-inclusive) so the pool is a like-for-like HR pool. Cycle 75 audit.

36331190.outcome: Trial-defined major kidney / cardiorenal composite (components differ by trial)
36331190.source: EMPA-KIDNEY (PMID 36331190) abstract: primary composite (kidney disease progression or CV death) in empagliflozin vs 558/3305 (16.9%) placebo (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001). SCALE CORRECTION (override): pool the reported kidney-composite HR, not the count-derived RR.
36331190.verification: Reported HR 0.72 (0.64-0.82) verbatim; primary composite CV-death-inclusive, consistent with DAPA-CKD (0.61) and CREDENCE (0.70) primaries. Resolves the sglt2-ckd mixed HR/RR pool to clean HR. Cycle 75 audit.
